2014_spells.inflict-wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
2014_spells.inflict-wounds.effectSummary: Deal 3d10 necrotic damage to a target within Touch
2014_spells.inflict-wounds.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
